train: Original V7 companies, targets first published 2010-2014; all features available at origin
dev: Original V7 companies, 2015-2016; consumed development data
holdout: New fixed company list below, 2017-2021; never used to fit or select
hypotheses: bounded analyst selects from numeric forecasts
earnings quality analyst favors recurring operating indicators over unusual net income
trained non-neural forecasts or simple combinations outperform hand rules
selection: Highest equal-family official composite on dev; one frozen primary pipeline. Agent ablations evaluated descriptively, never selected using holdout.
primary_metric: Equal-weight EPS direction and EPS growth, official scorer 5.2.2 with exact evidence quotes and V6 reference
meaningful_gain: Primary holdout mean minus V7 >= 0.03 and paired 95% quarterly block bootstrap lower bound > 0; also compare V6

bootstrap.unit: calendar target quarter; both families share a block

models: Research agent is Codex session proxy, not House. Numeric models trained only on train. Candidate forecasts bounded; no arbitrary model-generated numbers.
limitations: Synthetic source presentations from SEC XBRL, not full filing extraction
Only EPS task families; does not establish full track score
Current API extraction filtered by original filing dates, not archived API vintages
Agent proxy is stronger/different than runtime House; pretraining leakage mitigated by anonymous normalized inputs but not excluded
Historical corpora end before 2022; selected surviving US companies are not a random market sample
Exact-quote research judge, not production NLI verifier
